ANNUAL REPORT - LAND SALES BRANCH.

The lands sold during the year amounted to 48,903 3/4 acres, and the sales to $54,192.84. These lands are, for the most
part, situated in various parts of the Province Of Ontario.

The collections on account of old and new sales and leases amounted to $70,475.65.
The quantity of land still in the market is, in round numbers, 493,000 acres.
New land sales entered, 536.
Payments on leases entered, 441.
Agents' returns examined, etc., 158.
Assignments of lands examined and registered 355.
Descriptions for patents examined, etc., and a corresponding number of patents examined, 339.
Cancellations of sales, 32.


L. VANKOUGHNET,
Deputy Supt.-Gen. of Indian Affairs.

J.V. DEBOUCHERVILLE,
Clerk in charge of Land Sales.
DEPARTMENT OF INDIAN AFFAIRS,
OTTAWA, 30th June, 1882.
